mod.help: Settings for the Anim Cancel mod.

guard.title: Guard
guard.help: Raising your guard cancels the animations you pick (not while dual wielding).

dodge.title: Dodge
dodge.help: Rolling or backstepping cancels the animations you pick.

weapon_swap.title: Weapon swap
weapon_swap.help: Switching weapons cancels the animations you pick.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Turn this action's cancelling on or off.

spells.label: Spells
spells.help: Can cancel casting sorceries and incantations.

items.label: Items
items.help: Can cancel using items such as flasks.

log.label: Log file
log.help: Write a log file next to the DLL, for troubleshooting.
